name: Purpleish Pink
lede: Purpleish Pink is a vivid magenta-pink, another compound from the 2010 xkcd color survey, pairing "purpleish" with [[pink]].

sections.title: A compound crowd name
sections.body:
Like its blue counterpart, this name follows the survey's modifier-plus-base grammar, here purpleish over pink [1]. The xkcd survey of 2010 is the only record on file; no earlier dictionary or dye name is documented for it [1]. The ISCC-NBS system would place it among the deep purplish pinks, though at a loose fit, 10.9 units off [1].

Its nearest named neighbor is [[pink-purple]], 3.4 units away and more vivid still [2]. [[pinky-purple]] and [[hot-magenta]] sit a little further off, and the survey's near-duplicate [[purplish-pink]] is 5.3 units away and duller [2].

sections.title: Field notes
sections.body: Our full-canvas search finds no match in the 23,781-painting archive, but a narrower, within-painting search turns up a single trace, as photographed [3]. That single trace is too thin to draw a pattern from [3]. The color's high chroma makes it an unlikely survivor on an aged, varnished canvas in any case [3].
